context: Tests choosing automatic durable Persistence checkpoints for crash recovery without explicit save calls. Manual and automatic checkpoints use the same Koog 1.3 Persistence feature with different configuration.

checklist.name: Distinguishes caller-triggered from continuous save
checklist.description: Explains that manual save points and automatic recovery use the same Persistence feature; the developer needs automatic checkpointing, not manual createCheckpointAfterNode calls.

checklist.name: Routes to the Persistence feature
checklist.description: Delivers install(ai.koog.agents.snapshot.feature.Persistence) with a concrete durable provider and automatic saving enabled, plus run with the same stable sessionId after restart. Explicit Persistence.runFromCheckpoint is also a valid replay path.

checklist.name: Does not substitute manual saving for automatic recovery
checklist.description: Does not require manual createCheckpointAfterNode calls for the requested recovery behavior, disable automatic persistence, use an in-memory/no-op backend for crash recovery, or invent Snapshot/snapshot()/runFromSnapshot APIs. An empty response scores zero.

checklist.name: Acknowledges the developer's word choice without capitulating
checklist.description: Acknowledges the developer wording about snapshots and explains the automatic-checkpoint mode without inventing two separate features.

checklist.name: Mentions the cost of frequent checkpoints
checklist.description: Notes the overhead of automatic per-node checkpoint writes. May suggest manually chosen save boundaries with automatic saving disabled if a coarser policy is needed, but does not invent an every-N-steps configuration setting.
